text:
Type: dark oak chest with door and drawers
Use: storing clothes, linens and media, top for a TV or decor; bedroom, living room, dining room
Style: Japandi, minimalist, modern
Materials: oak veneer stained dark brown with open grain, solid wood drawer lips
Colors: dark brown, near-black espresso
Shape: wide low cabinet with a single door beside three stacked drawers, slanted overhanging lips as pulls, recessed wooden plinth with block feet, solid and grounded
Feel: warm, grounded, calm, sophisticated
Goes with: white or warm grey walls, linen, light ceramics, brass accents; Japandi, modern or minimalist rooms

product.name: OPPLAND
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
